title: fix(formula): list-equality prescribes a rewrite that works at each site, and judges a flow condition only where the run binds the typed row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbPgGMxS6cCEEprR4e3dQNe9)_

Fixes #36167

This is the card's last item: the builder half (#36185) and the validator half (#36207) are merged, and the remaining follow-ups have their own cards (#36217 skills text, #36218 review follow-ups, #36219 the as-you-type editor).

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #36217

## 维护者速读

- 作者把多值字段（多选、多人等）与单个值比较相等时，系统给出的改写建议现在在每个位置都能用：共享规则条件里也能用，且建议本身加了括号，不会被前面的条件拆开；由接口、定时或无触发方式启动的流程里，这种写法不再被误拒。
- 属于「表达式校验与作者护栏」：上一个已合并的拉取请求开始拒绝这种写法，复审发现它给的改写在共享规则里无法生效、部分写法会报错，还会误拒正确的流程条件。
- 若出错，作者看到的只是另一种改写建议，或某个流程条件不再被拦下；本改动可以整体撤回，不影响已存储的数据。
- 无

## What changes

Follow-up to #36207, which merged before its round-4 review findings were addressed. This PR covers four of them: r05 S1, r05 S2, r05 S4 / r06 N1, and r06 S1.

**The prescribed rewrite is spelled for its site and parenthesised whole** (`listMembershipRewrite` in `packages/formula/src/validate.ts`). Each spelling below was measured on the site's own evaluator or filter compiler:

| site | `==` rewrite | `!=` rewrite |
|---|---|---|
| a `record.` / `previous.` read evaluated as CEL (validation rule, field rule, formula, action `visible` / `disabled` / `pressed`, hook condition) | `(has(record.f) && record.f != null && "v" in record.f)` | `(!has(record.f) \|\| record.f == null \|\| !("v" in record.f))` |
| a bare name at a flow condition (the run binds every declared field, `null` when empty) | `(f != null && "v" in f)` | `(f == null \|\| !("v" in f))` |
| a sharing rule `condition`, compiled to a query filter (new `ExprSchemaHint.filterCompiled`, filled by the publish lint) | `(record.f != null && record.f.contains("v"))` | `(record.f == null \|\| !record.f.contains("v"))` |

No single spelling works at every site, which is why the rewrite differs per site:

- `"v" in record.f` does not lower to a filter. `compileCelToFilter` answers "`in` requires a field on the left (got literal)", so the sharing rule is dropped as `sharing-rule-unlowerable-condition`.
- `has()` does not lower either ("unsupported operator call").
- On the CEL evaluator, `record.f.contains("v")` faults on a list, because there is no `list.contains` overload.
- `record.f != null && "v" in record.f` faults on a row that lacks the key ("No such key"), which a sparse action row does. It also faults on a null `previous`, as on a create.

The filter spelling lowers to `$and[{f:{$null:false}}, {f:{$contains:"v"}}]` and `$or[{f:{$null:true}}, {$not:{f:{$contains:"v"}}}]`. `$contains` on a JSON-stored (multi-value) column is membership in `matchesFilterCondition` and in driver-sql (`sql-driver-17590-json-column-membership.test.ts`). A number or boolean operand is passed as its text (`contains("3")`), since `$contains` compares text. The sharing-site message also says why `==` does not work there: the query filter refuses `$eq` against a list column.

**A flattened (flow) site is judged only where the run binds a row of the typed object** (r06 S1). `checkListEquality` now returns early at a `'flattened'` site unless `faultOutcome` is `'run-fails'`. That outcome is declared only on a record-triggered flow, or on a time-relative sweep of the typed object: the lint's `faultOutcomeOf` ledger, `validate-expressions.ts` around line 1632. On any other flow (API, schedule, no trigger), the ledger's own row says the run "holds what its entrance handed it". `seedRunVariables` flattens whatever record that is. So an API flow whose request body carries a string `labels` runs `labels == 'frontend'` correctly, and #36207 refused it. The MCP tool already passes this outcome for `flow_condition` (its default `triggerKind` is `record_change`). `registerFlow`'s advisory pass now passes it on the same flows (`runBindsTypedRow`, which this PR moves above the hint). Side effect: on those flows, the pass's logged type-mismatch lines take the `run-fails` wording that `os validate` already prints. It still only logs and never throws.

**Docblocks (r05 S4 / r06 N1).**
- `ExprSchemaHint.multiValueFields` now names the forms actually judged:
  - `record.f` / `previous.f` and the bracket spelling;
  - the optional spellings, which are refused as `invalid-cel` first;
  - the bare name, only at a flattened site with `run-fails`, excluding `flowVariables` and `bareNamesUnproven`;
  - comprehension-bound names, which are never the field.
- `ExpressionRefusalParams['list-equality']` now documents `reference` (the bracket spelling renders `record.f`; a bare name is the bare name) and the per-site `rewrite`.

**Semantic entry** `cel-list-equality-refused` now has the per-site replacement text and the narrowed surface. The surface adds the sharing rule condition and limits flows to the proven-row ones.

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/validate-list-equality-36167.test.ts`
  - New describe, "the prescribed rewrite tests membership where it is read". For each site class it takes the rewrite out of the refusal itself, pins its text, and runs it:
    - **CEL member read:** evaluated on rows `[a,b]` / `[b]` / `[]` / `null` / absent, and with `previous = null`. Each is also checked inside `record.name == 'x' && …`, `record.name == 'y' && …` and `false || …`, which pins the parenthesisation.
    - **Bare name:** evaluated with the row bound as top-level names.
    - **Filter:** lowered with `compileCelToFilter` and matched with `matchesFilterCondition` (with the column declared `tags`), including inside `&&`.
    - Each rewrite validates clean at its own site.
    - The CEL `in` form is shown not to lower.
  - New describe, "a flattened site with no proven row binding gets no verdict": bare and `record.` reads, `fail-closed` / `fail-open`, plus a proven-site control.
- `packages/formula/src/expression-refusal-codes.test.ts`: the two `list-equality` PINS carry the new rewrites. Two new pins cover the bare name at a proven flattened site and the `filterCompiled` site, with params and the whole message.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.list-equality-36167.test.ts`:
  - action `visible` rewrites pinned, and each validates clean;
  - a flow condition's bare `!=` rewrite pinned in the parenthesised form and accepted inside `stage == 'qa' && …`;
  - CONTROLS: an API, a trigger-less autolaunched and a scheduled flow get no list-equality, bare or `record.`;
  - new describe, the sharing rule `condition`: refused with the `contains` rewrite, and that rewrite draws no finding from the expression lint or from `validateSharingRuleEnforceability` (it lowers);
  - CONTROL: the CEL `in` forms draw `sharing-rule-unlowerable-condition` there.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/list-equality-advisory-36167.test.ts`:
  - `makeFlow` now states its trigger (`record-after-update`);
  - parenthesised bare rewrite pinned and not reported itself;
  - CONTROLS: API, scheduled and trigger-less flows report nothing;
  - premise: the bare rewrites answer per row on `evaluateCondition`, including `false && (…)`.
- Two fixtures fixed at `254d40cb` (they had never run; each stopped before the behaviour it pins):
  - the sharing-rule describe in the lint pin built its rule with a recipient type the spec does not have (`role`) and no rule `type`, so all three cases failed at the spec-validity guard. It now uses `type: 'criteria'` and a `team` recipient, as the other spec-valid sharing fixtures do;
  - the API-flow CONTROL in the service-automation pin carried no hook secret, so `registerFlow` refused the flow before the advisory pass ran. It now names a `secretRef` (ADR-0041).
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-validate-expression.list-equality-36167.test.ts`: the `flow_condition` rewrite is pinned and validates clean. CONTROL: `triggerKind` `api` / `schedule` / `none` get no list-equality.

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause ② for this diff: `yes (widening)`.** Two things widen:
  - it adds the optional public key `ExprSchemaHint.filterCompiled`;
  - flow conditions on API / scheduled / trigger-less flows are accepted again, after #36207 refused them.

  Nothing in this diff refuses more. The changed rewrite text and the narrower flattened scope are not narrowings. `Metadata-protocol: added` because an accepted value is restored, so every package moved is `minor`.
- The driver-sql leg of the filter rewrite is cited, not run here: `$contains` membership on a JSON column is pinned in `sql-driver-17590-json-column-membership.test.ts`, and `$not` is NULL-safe (#5146). This PR measures the lowering and `matchesFilterCondition`.
- Decision node `config.condition` in the lint: only the start node's gate and edge / branch conditions carry the flow's outcome. An inert node condition already has its own `flow-inert-node-condition` finding, and gets no list-equality verdict.
- L2 S1 carried by #36218 (scope !== 'record'); nits N1–N4 accepted.

## Verification

Final head `254d40cb` (handover head `5a29954a` + `origin/main` merged at `2b570445` + the two fixture fixes). Every reading below is at that head.

- Build closure `--filter '@objectstack/lint^...' --filter '@objectstack/mcp^...' --filter '@objectstack/service-automation^...' --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0. Later a full `pnpm build --concurrency=2`: 120/120 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Pins: formula `validate-list-equality-36167` + `expression-refusal-codes` 250/250 (the 8 bare-name failures of the handover run are gone); lint `validate-expressions.list-equality-36167` 27/27 (3 failed before the fixture fix); mcp `mcp-validate-expression.list-equality-36167` 15/15; service-automation `list-equality-advisory-36167` 22/22 (1 failed before the fixture fix).
- Full suites, one locked run, VERDICT command-exit 0: formula build + test 70 files / 2107 tests + typecheck exit 0; lint 225 files / 9434 tests + typecheck exit 0; mcp 83 files / 1467 tests + typecheck exit 0; service-automation 290 files / 4220 tests + typecheck exit 0; spec `src/migrations` 5 files / 198 tests.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (seven, each through ablation-replace WRAP mode under the lock)</summary>

Each mutation was proven on disk (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed) and restored (blob equal to the HEAD blob, empty `git diff HEAD`). Every mutated module is read from source by its suite, so there is no dist leg.

| ablation | file | pin result |
|---|---|---|
| delete the flattened proven-row early return | formula `validate.ts` | 5 failed / 245 passed (250) |
| never take the `filterCompiled` spelling | formula `validate.ts` | 13 failed / 237 |
| drop the outer parentheses of the `!=` member-read rewrite | formula `validate.ts` | 6 failed / 244 |
| drop `has()` from the `==` member-read rewrite | formula `validate.ts` | 4 failed / 246 |
| lint passes no `filterCompiled` at the sharing rule | lint `validate-expressions.ts` | 2 failed / 25 (27) |
| service-automation always declares `run-fails` | `flow-registration-checks.ts` | 3 failed / 19 (22): the API, scheduled and trigger-less CONTROLS |
| service-automation never declares `run-fails` | `flow-registration-checks.ts` | 5 failed / 17 (22) |

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --commands` at `254d40cb`: 96 families. `dispatch-gates --ran` with recorded exit codes: 96 derived, 96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero), every family exit 0.
- Three needed a prerequisite first and were re-run: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (exit 3 on the shallow clone until its pinned fixture commit was fetched, then exit 0); the cli `migrate-meta-engine-guidance` vitest (exit 1, MODULE_NOT_FOUND on an unbuilt `@objectstack/mcp` dist, then 3/3 after the full build); `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET, then exit 0 after the full build: 124 require entry points across 72 packages load).
- `check:type-check-debt` exit 0. `check:nul-bytes` OK. `overlap-check` VERDICT clean exit 0 against `origin/main` `2b570445` and #36333 (shares `validate.ts`, merges cleanly).
- CI at `254d40cb`: all 69 check-runs completed, every one success or skipped (Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, every Lint and Type Check lane, Test Core 10/10 shards, Test UI 16/16, Build Core, Dogfood Regression Gate).
- `test:repo` was not run locally (the diff touches no repo-project test); CI's Test Core ran it.

</details>

Dogfood battery: n/a (no `!` in the title, and `Clause-②: yes (widening)` has no `(narrowing)` arm).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/formula exec vitest run src/validate-list-equality-36167.test.ts`. Expected: every test passes, including the "prescribed rewrite" and "no proven row" describes.

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/formula/src/validate.ts`: `listMembershipRewrite` and the early return in `checkListEquality`.
2. `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-registration-checks.ts`: `faultOutcome` on the advisory hint.
3. `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`: the sharing-rule `check(…, true)`.
